## Summary

Describe the user/research problem and the implemented change.

## Verification

- [ ] Python tests / Ruff pass for the changed area.
- [ ] Public dataset/report privacy contracts still pass when relevant.
- [ ] Web unit/type/build pass when Web code changes.
- [ ] Playwright regression passes when user-facing behavior changes.
- [ ] No raw media, lyric/OCR dumps, cookies, signed URLs, private paths/networks, or secrets are committed.
- [ ] New Reason/research claims remain evidence-backed and do not imply causal success prediction.
